page.overview:
Who is Amido?

is a quanikka connected to the Volition. As an NPC, he is played by Matthew Mercer.

Amido is tall, somewhat older, and covered in pale grey-white fur, although his head is balding.

In 843 PD, after Bells Hells located the most recent safe house of the Volition in Kreviris, they met Amido, who at first didn't trust them and questioned them about why they were there, getting increasingly nervous when the Exandrians started acting suspicious. However, when they proved they weren't aligned with the Imperium, Amido relaxed and allowed them to go meet the members of the Volition, mentioning the relevant figures the adventurers would have to meet. He received several blueberries Druidcrafted by Orym as a thanks.

Amido welcomed Bells Hells and the Mighty Nein to the Delta Dust Pit but was cautious and nervous, saying he no longer was a part of the Volition since "the last attempt".
